content: Kana tauya Yaubada diʼwenaya
Maʼoda ʼinega veʼaeʼaetoga be vedavi ʼifoʼifoqe nuanimia? Ana ʼita ʼwafimi edi nuanua luveifana weaqina ge ami fata be taumiega ona ʼabiluvinemi, ta ʼesi oawahawafelemi ʼidia ta iluviluvinemi, waisa?

Emiavo edi kulufa oʼiteʼitedi ta omiʼa wese nuanuami yani diavona, ta ge ami fata ona ʼewedi, ʼinega onuanua sabi luveʼaligidi. Ta yani diavona weaqidi onuanua govaqa qiduana ta ge ami fata ona ʼewedi, e ʼinega emiavo maega oveʼaeʼaetoga be ovevedavi sabi ʼewadi, ta nawale ge oda lobedi, mana ge oda venoqi Yaubada ʼinaya yani diavona weaqidi.
Ta wese tuta nana ovevenoqi ge emi noqi adi veʼia oda lobedi, mana baʼe emi nuanua be Yaubada ena nuanua ge ida veʼaidega, ta ʼesi yani diavona weaqidi ovevenoqi benaʼena taumiega emi qaiawa weaqina.

Omiʼa kavona taha vavine moqanedi ida nogei ta mali ʼoloto maega ivelamoʼeno kavokavovo, mana omiʼa Yaubada onogea ta bwaʼobwaʼo ana kulufa be ana ilivu luveifadi nuami ʼewea. Ta niʼa oalamania tomeqabu baʼe ilivu luveifa diavona iviaviaqia taudi Yaubada ivevoalanea. ʼInega wese tomeqabu bwaʼobwaʼo ana yaniavo nuadi ʼewea ge adi fata be Yaubada maega ina veiaiana.
Vonahaqiaqi, baʼe ilivu nana weaqina Buki Nugwenugweina simana vonaya,
Ta Yaubada nuanuana qiduana ena iula ʼinega baʼe ilivu diavona kana nogedi, mana Buki Nugwenugweina ena simana vonaya,

content.text: ta ʼesi tonuawebui nuakolokoloyedi be iuiuledi.”

content: ʼInega ona awafelemi Yaubada ʼinaya. Ta Seitani ena nuanua ona nogea, ʼinega tauna wese nanogemi ta nadena natauya.
Ta ona tauya Yaubada diʼwe otaqinaya, ʼinega tauna wese namai diʼwemia. Omiʼa luveifana ana toviaqayavo nimami ona ʼutudi, ta wese omiʼa tovenuana magilafu giwalimi ona givevunavunaqidi.
Emi luveifana weaqina ona nuavita ta ona dou. Emi dagi ona giveluaʼuya, ta ʼesi ona dou! Ta ge wese ona qaiawa, ta ʼesi ona nuavita!
Ta ilivu nuvana ʼinega ona iwaʼodu Kaiwabu matanaya be ʼinega tauna nagivaneqemi.
Tomotau ge kana ʼawaluveifedi

Egwavo, tovetumaqana emiavo ge ona ʼawaluveifedi, mana ʼeguma taha toga taina naʼawaluveifea nage naluvinea e tauna Yaubada ena luvine veyani kavokavovoyea ta taunega luvine nana ʼawaʼawa luveifea. ʼInegana ge taha toga daluaqiaqiei be taunega Yaubada ena luvine naluvinei nage nahawagilei. Ta ʼesi tomotau qabuda ada luaqiaqi be Yaubada ena luvineavo kana vematamatayagedi.

Yaubada ana ʼaidega luvine ana Toviaqa be wese Toluvine Qiduana. Ta wese tauna ana ʼaidega otaqa ana fata tomotau naʼetoyavuidi nage naluveʼaligidi. ʼInega omiʼa maʼoda, nage luaqiaqiemi be emiavo ona ʼawaluveifedi nage ona veʼewedi? Gebu!
Ge kana vonavane

Onoqola aqiaqiegu, mana vaina taumiega ogivaneqemi ovonaya, “Baʼitagana nage ʼibe kana tauya taha ʼabaga qiduana ʼinaya, ta yaʼwala ʼaidegana omode kana toa, ta eda kulufa kana vegimwaneyedi be yaqisa eda mane qiduana kana ʼewea.”
Ta gebu oda alamania tolaʼai ʼibe naʼifoqe ʼimia, mana itaʼa tomotau yawaida ʼidewani gawata naʼifoqe ta tuta goyona nahawala.
Ta ʼesi luaqiaqiemi be me emi nuawebui baʼe ʼedewani ona vonaya, “ʼEguma Kaiwabu ena nuanua be mayawaida kana toatoa, e ʼinega kana tutuvila kana tauya ta yani taha taha kana viaqidi.”
Ta baʼitagana ovonavona vane emi nuanuayavo weaqidi, ta ona nuaveʼavinia vonavane yani luveifana.
ʼInega baʼe ona alamani aqiaqiea: ʼEguma tomotau ilivu aqiaqina ana viaqa niʼa ialamania ta ge ida viaqi, e ʼinega baʼe yani luveifa otaqina Yaubada matanaya.
